en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2875 - Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):

"Can a man perform Hajj on behalf of a Nasibi (one who harbors enmity toward the Ahlulbayt)?"
Imam (as) replied: "No."

I said: "What if it was my father?"
Imam (as) said: "If it was your father, then perform Hajj on his behalf."
